name: Tom tich
summary: Tôm tích, also written tôm tít, is the mantis shrimp Dân Việt calls a Cần Giờ specialty. The plate the story walks through is cháy tỏi, burnt garlic, on large animals. Thanh Niên names tôm tích among the three things sellers said visitors ask for at Hàng Dương, with ghẹ and ốc.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022, on the town streets. Thanh Niên, 11 Mar 2019, at chợ hải sản Hàng Dương.
howToEat: Crack it at the table. Dân Việt notes that a small one leaves little meat once the shell is off, and describes large shrimp, about two animals near 300 g.

The same story lists other cooks: steamed with ginger, steamed with lemongrass, grilled plain, grilled with cheese, grilled with mỡ hành, tossed with tamarind, or tossed with salt and chili, and salt and garlic. It does not print a recipe for each.
Dân Việt prints 900,000 VND a kilogram on 2 Oct 2022, including the cooking, and says the price moves with the season. A 2026 board was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The town streets, đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, or chợ hải sản Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới. The hour is Check on arrival.

seoDescription: Tôm tích is mantis shrimp in Can Gio. Dân Việt describes cháy tỏi and lists other cooks. A 2 Oct 2022 kilogram price is not a 2026 board. Check on arrival.
texture: Dân Việt calls the meat sweet, and says a small shell leaves little of it.
taste: Burnt garlic with the sweet meat, on the plate the story describes. The other cooks are named and not tasted out.
